mapper.sql: location_groups.id AS warehouseId, location_groups.name AS warehouseName, locations.id AS id, locations.name AS `name`, locations.is_for_sale AS isForSale, locations.is_active AS isActive, locations.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, locations.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM locations LEFT JOIN location_groups ON location_groups.id = locations.location_group_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = locations.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = locations.modified_by
WHERE locations.is_active = 1 AND locations.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR location_groups.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO locations ( `name`, location_group_id, created, created_by, is_for_sale, is_active ) VALUES ( #{section.locationName}, #{section.warehouseId}, NOW(), #{section.createdBy}, #{section.isForSale}, #{section.isActive} )

CREATE TABLE `${locationId}_inventory_totals` ( `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `location_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `lots_number` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `expired_date` date NOT NULL, `total_qty` decimal(15,3) DEFAULT '0.000', `total_order` decimal(15,3) DEFAULT '0.000' ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;
ALTER TABLE `${locationId}_inventory_totals` ADD PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`,`location_id`,`lots_number`,`expired_date`), ADD KEY `index_keys` (`product_id`,`location_id`,`lots_number`,`expired_date`);

CREATE TABLE `${locationId}_inventory_total_details` ( `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `location_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `lots_number` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `expired_date` date NOT NULL, `total_cycle` decimal(15,3) DEFAULT '0.000', `total_so` decimal(15,3) DEFAULT '0.000', `total_pos` decimal(15,3) DEFAULT '0.000', `total_pb` decimal(15,3) DEFAULT '0.000', `total_pbc` decimal(15,3) DEFAULT '0.000', `total_cm` decimal(15,3) DEFAULT '0.000', `total_to_in` decimal(15,3) DEFAULT '0.000', `total_to_out` decimal(15,3) DEFAULT '0.000', `total_order` decimal(15,3) DEFAULT '0.000', `date` date NOT NULL ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;
ALTER TABLE `${locationId}_inventory_total_details` ADD PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`,`location_id`,`lots_number`,`expired_date`,`date`), ADD KEY `index_keys` (`product_id`,`location_id`,`lots_number`,`expired_date`,`date`);
